change_policy: Evaluation Spec 1.7 is frozen for forward evidence. Only a demonstrated evidence-contamination or integrity defect may justify a future Spec change, and only through a reviewed PR plus evidence-lock update. Forward evidence accumulated under an older Spec remains archived under that Spec and must never be mixed with a later Spec. No statistical threshold may be changed to improve named-method outcomes.
hash_policy: Git blob SHA-1 of exact repository bytes; any file-byte change requires reviewed config lock update.
